facts.text: Families watch local weather reports on television before outdoor gatherings.
A resident listens to the morning radio while driving to work.
A local newspaper prints school sports results and community announcements.
Some residents read the town newspaper through its website.
A library lends printed books and digital reading materials.
A child borrows a picture book from the public library.
A teenager shares a short video with friends through a social app.
A household chooses between live television and programs available on demand.
A viewer turns on captions to follow a program in a noisy room.
A family watches a rented digital movie together on a weekend evening.
A local radio station announces road closures after a storm.
A church posts its weekly bulletin online for members to read.
A school sends event reminders through email and its website.
A resident checks a printed community calendar for upcoming fairs.
A music listener plays a downloaded album when internet service is unavailable.
Some drivers listen to spoken stories and interviews during long trips.
A community theater advertises performances on posters around town.
A shop displays a flyer advertising the next local craft market.
A family keeps old photo albums alongside pictures stored on phones.
A resident calls a local radio program to request a song.
A library bulletin board lists book discussions and children's reading hours.
During 2020, many local theaters close temporarily or limit screenings.
During 2020, some congregations broadcast services while indoor gatherings are restricted.
During 2021, some movie theaters reopen with adjusted seating or cleaning practices.
A resident receives a printed advertising circular with the weekly mail.
Neighbors discuss a local news story after hearing different accounts of the same event.
